name: Webcam
author: nixbiks
description: Turn the IPU6 webcam bridge on and off. Off, the camera costs nothing; on, the relay takes ~10% of a core whether or not anything reads it.

barWidget.description: On-demand IPU6 camera bridge (v4l2-relayd@ipu7). Lit means the relay is running and paying for it; warns when it runs without being asked.
